***The Power of Fashion in the Roman Empire** is the largest special exhibition on antiquity in the history of the museum.

Step into a world of colour, drapery, magnificent footwear and fabulous hairstyles as the exhibition The Power of Fashion in the Roman Empire explores fashion in antiquity for the very first time. This ambitious special exhibition, extending over more than 1,000 m2 is a first in Denmark and internationally.1 October 2026 - 29 March 2027.

[Read more](/whats-on/guided-tours/power-fashion-tour)*

### The Winter Garden with its lush palms and iconic glass dome is the centerpiece and landmark of the Glyptotek.

Visit the museum's green heart, from where you are guided to the museum's various exhibitions, café, and shop.

You can also sit down and enjoy the surroundings.

[Architecture](/explore/architecture)

### Combine your visit with coffee and cake at the café, Picnic.

Visit Picnic and enjoy delicious lunch dishes, desserts, coffee, and other beverages.

[Picnic - Café](/visit/picnic-cafe)

### Visit the Glyptotek Museum Shop.

Here you will find a large and carefully selected range of products for both adults and children, inspired by the museum's extensive collection, the history of the building, and the museum's current special exhibitions.

[Museum Shop](/visit/museumshop)

**The city's most beautiful view.**

From the roof terrace above Henning Larsen's building, you can see across Copenhagen and the Glyptotek's varied roof landscape.

The roof terrace is only open when the weather permits.

[The Building](/explore/architecture)
